rationale: This is a global recovery scheduling limit, distinct from per-run request concurrency and from the deterministic list of initial waves. It bounds simultaneously live wave work and cannot be derived from wave membership or ordering.
alternatives: remove: would leave recovery concurrency implicit and uncontrolled
rename to max_concurrent_waves: adds no useful distinction; active is the established lifecycle term
simplestChoice: Keep max_active_waves as the recovery-policy concurrency cap.
